title: Print Cost Calculator
description: Cost per page from cartridge price and yield plus paper cost.
howto: Enter your black cartridge price and its rated page yield.
Optionally enter a color cartridge price and yield (leave 0 for mono only).
Enter paper cost per ream and sheets per ream.
Enter how many mono and color pages you print, and read the per-page and total costs.

faqs.a: The manufacturer's rated number of pages per cartridge, usually at 5% coverage. Real coverage varies, so treat this as a baseline.
Paper is a real per-page cost: ream price divided by sheets per ream. It applies to both mono and color pages.

faqs.q: How is a color page costed?
faqs.a: Color page cost = color cartridge cost per page + paper cost. If you print mixed pages, enter the counts separately.
